name: NEOTOKYO° OST Main Menu Music
teaser: Yet another main menu music replacement mod. This one adds the OST from NEOTOKYO°. Peak cyberpunk vibes that somehow fit perfectly with EFT's atmosphere. A dystopia is a dystopia after all.
description_html:
For 3.9+, this soundtrack can be found on Bobby’s Music Player mod page.

Oh boy, here comes yet another main menu music replacement mod.

This one adds the soundtrack from NEOTOKYO°, a niche Source mod that’s free on Steam.

The whole playlist is dark and broody, with hints of desolation that give cyberpunk that classic dystopian vibe. I’ve been using it for years, and I’m still not sick of it.

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=_O01K8sNeDo

Going off Spotify’s numbering and Bandcamp’s albums, here’s the track list:

Disk 1 - Neotokyo GSDFDisk 2 - Neotokyo NSF1. Annul
2. Tin Soldiers
3. Beacon
4. Imbrium
5. Automata
6. Hiroden 651
7. Tachi
8. Sprawl
9. Mechanism
10. Paperhouse
11. Footprint17. Prabhava
18. Distance
19. Impetus
20. Carapace
21. Stopgap
25. Haka
26. Surface
I omitted some songs because either they were a bit grating to listen, or were too cyber rather than punk, and it’s the latter that fits with EFT.

Installation:

Drag and drop the BepInEx folder from the 7z into your SPT folder.

Credits:

Ed Harrison for this amazing soundtrack. You can check out the OST on his Bandcamp here.
